news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹1,047, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 11x. Average forward P/E is 15x in the Diversified Financial industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 136% over the past three years. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹722 per share.

news.title: PNBHOUSING: Dividend Momentum And Leadership Changes Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target for PNB Housing Finance from ₹1,069.09 to ₹1,184.17, reflecting updated assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E expectations. What's in the News The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹8 per equity share with a face value of ₹10 for FY26, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting (Key Developments).

news.title: Price target increased by 8.5% to ₹1,133
news.body: Up from ₹1,045, the current price target is an average from 12 analysts. New target price is 9.6% above last closing price of ₹1,034. Stock is up 6.4% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹91.62 for next year compared to ₹88.01 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹88.01 (up from ₹74.52 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹35.0b (up 6.8% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹22.9b (up 18% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 65% (up from 59% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was primarily driven by lower expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 3.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 30% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: PNBHOUSING: Leadership Changes And Strong Margins Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target on PNB Housing Finance slightly lower from about ₹1,094 to around ₹1,069, reflecting updated assumptions around discount rates, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E expectations. What's in the News A special or extraordinary shareholders meeting is scheduled for Mar 12, 2026 via postal ballot in India to consider appointing Ajai Kumar Shukla as managing director and chief executive officer, appointing Dipankar Mahapatra as nominee non executive director, and approving sitting fees for non executive nominee director Dilip Kumar Jain (Key Developments).

news.title: Now 21% overvalued
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 19% to ₹817. The fair value is estimated to be ₹675, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has been flat over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 14%. For the next 3 years, revenue is forecast to grow by 13% per annum. Earnings are also forecast to grow by 8.4% per annum over the same time period.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹19.97 (vs ₹18.60 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹19.97 (up from ₹18.60 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹9.08b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹5.20b (up 7.7% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 57% (down from 59% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 16% per year.

news.title: PNBHOUSING: Leadership Change Will Support Continued Strength In Core Business
news.body: Narrative Update on PNB Housing Finance Analysts have kept their price target for PNB Housing Finance broadly unchanged around ₹1,094, citing only marginal tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future valuation assumptions that together leave their fundamental outlook intact. What's in the News Managing Director and CEO Girish Kousgi will step down after a three year tenure effective October 28, 2025, to pursue external opportunities, and has joined IIFL Home Finance (company disclosure).

news.title: PNBHOUSING: Leadership Transition And Planned Fundraising Will Support Future Momentum
news.body: Analysts have slightly adjusted their price target for PNB Housing Finance, keeping it at ₹1,094.17, due to a marginal decrease in the discount rate and stable growth assumptions. What's in the News Girish Kousgi resigned after a three-year term as Managing Director and CEO, effective October 28, 2025, to pursue external opportunities.
